summary: SlotNow iteration 40 full-stack verification for Admin phone lockdown + Per-date availability overrides + Queue-based smart reminders + Provider analytics. Backend: 18/18 pytest cases pass covering (a) admin PIN + verify-otp lockdown to 9412575970 with 403 for 9999999999 (customer role unaffected), (b) overrides CRUD (POST/GET/DELETE) + validation (shift requires start_time/end_time), (c) override drives /providers/{id}/slots (schedule_scope='override_closed' with has_schedule=false, and 'override_shift' with only the one-off shift), (d) POST /bookings on closed override date rejected 400 'unavailable', (e) booking on shift override succeeds at its start_time, (f) new booking auto-sets reminder20_sent + reminder3_sent when queue is empty (position 0), (g) analytics returns totals/capacity/utilisation_pct/heatmap[7][24]/per_staff[] and honors ?staff_id filter, (h) admin regression endpoints (stats, subscription-analytics, referrals) still 200 with allowed admin phone, (i) hospital_default fallback slot regression. Frontend: admin lockdown honored on /login (blocked phone stays on /login, allowed phone reaches /admin), Provider Dashboard shows data-testid provider-open-analytics which navigates to /provider/analytics, analytics page renders kpi-total/kpi-completed/kpi-cancelled/kpi-noshow, analytics-util-pct, analytics-range-{7,30,90}, heat-0-10, and analytics-staff-select (hospital provider), and HospitalStaffSchedule override editor supports ov-kind-{closed,shift}/ov-date/ov-start/ov-end/ov-max/ov-note/ov-add-btn — add creates ov-row-{id}, ov-remove-{id} removes it end-to-end.

issues: The 'Mark unavailable' / 'Add extra shift' primary button (ov-add-btn) sits directly above the bottom nav bar and can be partially obscured on shorter viewports (< ~950px). Reproduced under viewport 1440x900: Playwright click even with force=True did not fire the POST; JS-level click did. Recommend adding pb-24 spacer to the override card or moving the CTA higher so the bottom nav does not intercept clicks.

When there are no bookings for a hospital yet, per_staff array is empty so analytics-drill-{staff_id} buttons never render. Consider rendering a placeholder row per seeded doctor with 0 utilisation so the drill-down surface remains discoverable in the empty state.

action_items: (Low) Add bottom padding under the override CTA or lift it above the fixed bottom nav on /provider/staff/{id}/schedule so the button is not overlapped on shorter viewports.
(Low) When per_staff is empty, seed placeholder rows for each hospital_staff so analytics-drill-{staff_id} is still visible for QA/UX.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 3064 lines — still recommend splitting (routers: auth, providers/availability, providers/overrides, bookings, admin, analytics).

_notify_queue_positions currently writes note='SMS not live — reminder tracked only' when the settings row has enabled=False; the review request said the expected note ends with 'not configured on SMS settings'. Only the branch where SMS is live but reminder_template_id is missing yields that exact string. This is fine functionally (reminder record + booking flag toggle still happen) but the two note strings may confuse observers — consider unifying to 'reminder_template_id not configured on SMS settings' for both paths OR documenting the distinction in the SMS settings admin UI.

provider_analytics: heatmap weekday label in the frontend is ['Mon','Tue',...,'Sun'] (Python weekday order) while backend uses date.weekday() (0=Mon). Consistent — OK. Just flagging that if a future refactor swaps to JS getDay(), labels must also flip.

Overrides GET endpoint: staff_id filter uses `q['staff_id']=staff_id` — passing an empty string would filter to overrides whose staff_id == ''. Consider treating '' as None or explicitly rejecting empty string to avoid client bugs.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (admin lock, analytics page, override CRUD)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite for iteration 40: `pytest backend/tests/test_iter40_overrides_reminders_analytics.py -v`. Prior iteration 29 suite still runs: `pytest backend/tests/test_hospital_staff_schedule.py -v`. Key gotchas: (1) The frontend removeOverride uses window.confirm — Playwright must register a page.on('dialog', d.accept()) handler. (2) The ov-add-btn on /provider/staff/{id}/schedule can be visually overlapped by the bottom-nav — prefer JS click (`page.evaluate(...click())`) over `page.click(force=True)` for reliability. (3) Booking on TestHospital still requires service_type='Paid' + vehicle_reg_no + vehicle_model because the provider is under Automobile category. (4) TestQueueReminders relies on the booked slot being at position 0 in the queue — if other tests leave stale bookings for Cardio on the same next-Tuesday date, position won't be 0 and reminder3_sent may not flip; the test currently passes because it books on a future Tuesday with an empty queue.
